detail: Built a ticket with two criteria; grader scored criterion-2 at 2 with the gap. Pass 1 shows red at the grader gate, the ticket stayed in building (not merging) while pass 2 ran, and the pass-2 builder message holds the gap.

Two decided cards; grade 1 failed card-images and passed card-menu; grade 2 passed card-images and named a new small gap on card-menu without a regression flag. Build ended 'merging after 2 passes', pass 2 went on to the reviewers.

Only reviewer-security reported HIGH. All five reviewer launches began within 1 s (concurrent), pass 1 failed at gate reviewer with 'security HIGH at ok.txt:3', and the pass-2 builder message holds the impact and fix.
One MEDIUM and one unknown-severity finding: build ends 'merging after 1 pass', ticket column merging, both findings in the pass findings file in the pipeline log.
Grader launch record has --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash and --allowedTools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash(git diff/log/show:*); no Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit; the scores reached the loop (pass green).

Cap 5, passes 1-4 failed at the grader, pass 5 failed only the small gap on the cited card: build ends 'merging after 5 passes', follow-up r/02 filed, blocked_by r/01, cites the card and quotes the gap. The ticket stays in merging and never reaches done: only the merge loop (werk/38) moves it there; `werk build` stops at merging.

Cap 5, pass 5 misses a criterion and has a small gap: no follow-up filed, dependent r/02 still blocked_by r/01 and not done, reason 'red at the retry cap of 5', retries 5. But the ticket column is 'ready', not 'blocked' (src/build/loop.ts moves it to ready at the cap); step says it shows as blocked. Expected blocked, got ready.

--silence-ms 400, builder emits init then pauses. Session log has act 'silent' line, pass 2 brief contains 'silent', pass 1 red / pass 2 green; with --cap 1 the build ends 'ready after 1 pass' so the silent pass counts against the cap (retries 1).
Builder waits 900 ms before its first event with silence limit 400 ms: build ends 'merging after 1 pass' and the session log has no 'silent' act.

Two scripted asks; classifier replied allow with comment, then prose with no verdict. Log has 'allowed Bash make lint: fits the ticket' and the 'allowed' tool result, then 'denied Bash ls: the classifier gave no verdict' and 'The overseer denied this call: ...'; builder continued and the build merged.

Looping verdict with reason: pass 1 cancelled, log has act 'looping' and the reason, pass-2 brief contains the reason, build merges after 2 passes. In a second run (one tool call, 3 s pass, progress 300 ms) the classifier was launched exactly once, so it is not asked again without a new tool call.

Put a failing `ps` shim first on PATH of the werk process. With a long tool call (flat limit 300 ms) the log has 'probe-failed' acts, no 'frozen' or 'silent', and the pass ended when the call returned (merging after 1 pass). With a never-returning call and --agent-ms 2500 the pass ended at the wall-clock limit ('time limit' reason, ready after 1 pass), no frozen cancel.
